title: MindScope: Exploring cognitive biases in large language models through Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the MindScope dataset, which includes a static component of 5,170 open-ended scenario questions spanning 72 decision-making cognitive biases (e.g., sunk cost fallacy, framing effect, IKEA effect) and a dynamic component of multi-turn dialogues simulated via a rule-based multi-agent framework (RuleGen). The biases are detected using an LLM-based multi-agent competitive debate framework incorporating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and a reinforcement learning decision module.
